items.stem: A user asks for a company's revenue 'as of fiscal 2022' but the system returns the latest year's figure. What is the failure?

options.text: Retrieval is not time-aware, so it ignored the requested reporting period
options.rationale: Correct: point-in-time retrieval must honour the requested period.

options.text: The embedding model is too large
options.rationale: Model size is not the issue.

options.text: The user asked an impossible question
options.rationale: The question is answerable with time-aware retrieval.
Revenue is a standard filing figure.

items.explanation: Correct: point-in-time retrieval must honour the requested period.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices reduce wrong-number answers from financial filings? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Preserve units and scale (e.g. thousands vs millions) during parsing
options.rationale: Correct: lost scale produces order-of-magnitude errors.

options.text: Ground each figure to its exact source and refuse on weak evidence
options.rationale: Correct: figure-level grounding plus refusal prevents confident wrong answers.
That destroys the structure figures depend on.

options.text: Always return the most recent figure

items.explanation: Correct: lost scale produces order-of-magnitude errors.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: The assistant produces a precise figure but cannot point to a source passage. What should it do?

options.text: Refuse or hedge, since an ungrounded figure is not trustworthy in this domain
options.rationale: Correct: in high-stakes finance, ungrounded numbers must not be asserted.
Confidence without grounding is unsafe here.

options.text: Round the number and present it
options.rationale: Rounding does not fix the lack of evidence.

options.text: Ask the model to estimate from memory

items.explanation: Correct: in high-stakes finance, ungrounded numbers must not be asserted.
